question: Annavocado avocado oil company owner manufacturer
markdown:
Annavocado
is a wellness brand and vertically integrated supplier that sources Hass avocados from its own orchards in the Bay of Plenty, New Zealand, and produces cold-pressed avocado oil and supplements. The company was co-founded by
Anna
(who serves as a general manager/co-founder) alongside operations managed via
Annavocado Co. Ltd.
Annavocado
Company & Manufacturing Overview
Orchard & Sourcing:
Owns and manages Hass avocado trees planted in mineral-rich volcanic soil in the Bay of Plenty region of New Zealand.
Annavocado
Extraction:
Avocados are hand-picked and cold-pressed into pure oil in New Zealand, then temperature-controlled and encapsulated into vegan softgels or products.
Quality Assurance:
Tested via independent laboratories like AsureQuality New Zealand and Hill Laboratories for residue-free purity.
